## Summary

Describe the documentation or API-contract change and the reader or client impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_examples.py`
- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py`
- [ ] Request/response examples updated if schemas changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for externally visible changes
- [ ] Rendered documentation reviewed if the PDF was changed

## Review notes

Call out compatibility concerns, lifecycle/state changes, authorization changes, or areas that need special reviewer attention.
